rules.reason: The user needs to inspect or manipulate a spatial subject.
constraints: semantic DOM for product facts and actions
rules.fallback: Use a responsive static gallery or turntable with the same content and controls.

rules.reason: Layered composition can add narrative depth without a live 3D renderer.
constraints: semantic DOM for reading and navigation
rules.fallback: Use the final layered composition with direct state changes and no travel.

rules.reason: The primary need is fast comprehension or task completion.
rules.fallback: The semantic interface is the complete experience and needs no visual enhancement.

default.reason: No spatial or narrative need was established.
default.fallback: Keep the standard responsive interface as the complete experience.
